channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about David Fizdale | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about David Fizdale from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Bradley Beal on David Fizdale
item.description:
“Where we can improve at and just putting myself in that position — telling coach, telling [assistant coach David Fizdale] that that’s an assignment I want every night.”

Bradley Beal on David Fizdale, Nov 6, 2024. Source: Arizona's Sports Page.

item.title: Elfrid Payton on David Fizdale
item.description:
Elfrid Payton on playing under David Fizdale in New York:

“Funniest shit tho…we come into practice, and we go in the film room. Andthis n**** put on like a Martin Luther King speech or something like that… before that, assistant coach comes on talking about some ‘Thieves in the Temple’… what are we talking about my n**** we got a game tomorrow. What coverage we in, like f*ck is you talking ‘bout dawg”

Elfrid Payton on David Fizdale, Feb 1, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Elfrid Payton on David Fizdale
item.description:
Elfrid Payton on David Fizdale’s final days in New York:

“They come in, they put on the MLK thing, he get up and it’s like, ‘you don’t always get to see the foundation that you made’ or something like that, something crazy like that. Alright whateva.”

Elfrid Payton on David Fizdale, Feb 1, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Chris Bosh on Jason Kidd, David Fizdale
item.description:
Bosh explained what Fizdale will bring to the Lakers:

“He’s gonna bring, of course, that coach who loves to get into film, knows a lot about the game. He brings a presence that’s great for a locker room as well because he loves nothing more than basketball. And him being an L.A. guy, coming back home to be able to coach for the Lakers, I mean that’s a dream come true, for sure. And he’s filling a void left by Jason Kidd, him moving onto a head coaching spot, I’m sure that they will need another presence to fill in that bench. And I think for Fizdale, he’s one of the best guys out there as you guys know. We talk all the time, and he’s ready, he’s eager, he’s excited. And I know he’s gonna do a fantastic job with Vogel’s staff out there in L.A.”

Chris Bosh on Jason Kidd, David Fizdale, Jul 7, 2021. Source: lebronwire.usatoday.com.

item.title: Michael Malone on David Fizdale
item.description:
Mike Vorkunov:Mike Malone on Knicks firing Fizdale:

“They made the change they felt was appropriate. Obv there has been so much written about... since David has been fired in terms of ‘Is David the fall guy?’‘Does it start up higher — front office, ownership?’ I can’t answer those questions.”

Michael Malone on David Fizdale, Dec 15, 2019. Source: Twitter @MikeVorkunov.

item.title: Patrick Ewing on David Fizdale
item.description:
Patrick Ewing on SiriusXM radio supports David Fizdale:

“Very disappointed in (him getting fired by the Knicks). I think that Fiz is an outstanding coach.”

Patrick Ewing on David Fizdale, Dec 10, 2019. Source: Twitter @SBondyNYDN.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on David Fizdale
item.description:
Anthony Puccio:Kenny Atkinson on the David Fizdale firing:

“It doesn't make you feel good as a colleague, and a friend quite honestly. I know it's part of this business... But he's an excellent coach. He'll be back for sure.”

Kenny Atkinson on David Fizdale, Dec 6, 2019. Source: Twitter @APOOCH.

item.title: Julius Randle on David Fizdale
item.description:
Julius Randle:

“There’s a lot of new pieces. Everyone’s going to be trying to figure out their role. Coach [David Fizdale] is going to do a great job of helping us through that. If we want to be a good team and have a chance, we have to jump-start that process ourselves.”

Julius Randle on David Fizdale, Aug 24, 2019. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Wayne Ellington on David Fizdale
item.description:
“That’s one of the things [Knicks coach David Fizdale] and I spoke about, helping to lead. And of course, I’m here be a player, whether it’s starting or coming off the bench, whatever Fiz needed me to do, I’m going to be ready and prepared for it. That’s really not my main focus, whether I’m a starter or not, but I’m definitely coming in here to compete.”

Wayne Ellington on David Fizdale, Aug 22, 2019. Source: Newsday.

item.title: Steve Mills on Scott Perry, David Fizdale
item.description:
“We laid out a plan when (GM) Scott (Perry) came on board and then (coach) David (Fizdale) joined us that we were going to build this team the right way,”

Steve Mills on Scott Perry, David Fizdale, Jun 21, 2019. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Emmanuel Mudiay on David Fizdale
item.description:
And Mudiay acknowledged the uncertainty before the Rockets game for the first time.

“I feel like I owed [Fizdale] a lot, especially the organization because they gave me a chance. He let me go out there and be myself, so any time I was going through something, I always thought about something that he would have done for me,”

Emmanuel Mudiay on David Fizdale, Apr 6, 2019. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Kevin Knox on David Fizdale
item.description:
“Like Fizdale said, not a lot of teams have 14 guys that show up to summer workouts. I feel like it’s going to help us in the long runbecause our chemistry is just building stronger and stronger every single day as the summer goes on.”

Kevin Knox on David Fizdale, Sep 21, 2018. Source: Bergen Record.

item.title: Lance Thomas on David Fizdale
item.description:
Lance Thomas on Fizdale:

“I’m just very excited that he’s coming in and he’s talking about defense, something that we haven’t been very good at. He’s talking about making guys better. I got chills when he’s talking about Emmanuel, making him a really hard to guard player.”

Lance Thomas on David Fizdale, May 8, 2018. Source: Twitter @MikeVorkunov.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on David Fizdale
item.description:
Heat coach Erik Spoelstra on NYK candidate & ex-MIA assistant David Fizdale:

“He’s a brilliant basketball mind & has gold-standard level communication skills.. I hope he goes West. That’s the kind of respect I have for him. I don’t want him going anywhere in the East.”

Erik Spoelstra on David Fizdale, Apr 17, 2018. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Tyreke Evans on David Fizdale
item.description:
Tyreke Evans:

“One of the reasons why I really came here to Memphis when I talked to (former Grizzlies head coach David Fizdale) and he told me he was gonna let me play my game. So other than that, man, I'm just glad to be here with my teammates again, the guys. If it would have happened, it just would have happened.”

Tyreke Evans on David Fizdale, Feb 26, 2018. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on David Fizdale
item.description:
Gregg Popovich on David Fizdale:

“You don't know what's going on in another organization, but you know the people. I know Fiz. Like I told him, he should have no trouble whatsoever being hired elsewhere at some point, sooner rather than later, because he did a hell of a job. He knows his stuff, he cares, he cares about community as much as he does on the court. You hate to see that, but I know what his value is and how much he cares. It's unfortunate that it happened. It doesn't do any good to blame – ‘It's because of this, it's because of that.' Everybody will just move on and hope that the team does well and that Fiz ends up well someplace else.”

Gregg Popovich on David Fizdale, Nov 29, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Michael Malone on DeMarcus Cousins, Mike Conley, David Fizdale
item.description:
“Mike Conley goes out. They go 0-7, 0-8. DeMarcus Cousins gets viral meningitis. We go two and whatever. And I get fired. He gets fired. David Fizdale is going to be back in the league as a head coach and he’ll be in a better situation just like I am.”

Michael Malone on DeMarcus Cousins, Mike Conley, David Fizdale, Nov 29, 2017. Source: BSN Denver.

item.title: Billy Donovan on David Fizdale
item.description:
Fred Katz:Billy Donovan on David Fizdale:

“I’m disappointed. I’ve known Fiz, just from being in the state of Florida... He’s a great guy. He’s a terrific coach. It’s unfortunate.”

Billy Donovan on David Fizdale, Nov 28, 2017. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on David Fizdale
item.description:
Ronald Tillery:Bickerstaff on whether David Fizdale lost the team:

“To a man, if you ask those guys, they believed in his vision. Whatever was put in front of them, they were willing to do.”

JB Bickerstaff on David Fizdale, Nov 28, 2017. Source: Twitter @CAGrizBeat.

item.title: Marc Gasol on David Fizdale
item.description:
Marc Gasol:

“I was shocked by (the firing)Me: Did you ask for Fizdale to be fired? Marc:”

Marc Gasol on David Fizdale, Nov 28, 2017. Source: Twitter @peteredmiston.

item.title: Mario Chalmers on David Fizdale
item.description:
Peter Edmiston:Mario Chalmers, on whether Fizdale had a problem with the locker room:

“Me being the new guy, I heard rumblings, but I never seen anything with my own eyes, I never really bought into that.”

Mario Chalmers on David Fizdale, Nov 28, 2017. Source: Twitter @peteredmiston.

item.title: Chris Wallace on David Fizdale
item.description:
“Coach Fizdale represented the Grizzlies and City of Memphis proudly, and we wish him well as he continues his career.”

Chris Wallace on David Fizdale, Nov 27, 2017. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on David Fizdale
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on Fizdale firing:

“Fiz is a fine young coach. Nobody likes to see those guys have a short tenure. He did a hell of a job,and I don’t think he is going to have any problem landing some place. He is a good man. He knows what he is doing, is tough minded. He will be fine.”

Gregg Popovich on David Fizdale, Nov 27, 2017. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: PJ Carlesimo on Gregg Popovich, David Fizdale
item.description:
“To even imply that the officials ref the Spurs differently, or Kawhi differently, is not a good place to go. I don’t know what he intended, but if he is implying the officials are not being fair because it’s Kawhi vs. Zach [Randolph] or David Fizdale vs. Gregg Popovich, that’s not something you want to be even hinting at.”

PJ Carlesimo on Gregg Popovich, David Fizdale, Apr 20, 2017. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on David Fizdale
item.description:
Vincent Goodwill:Dwyane Wade on Fizdale:

“As players, you feel better when your head coach sticks up for you and says the words you want to say.”

Dwyane Wade on David Fizdale, Apr 18, 2017. Source: Twitter @vgoodwill.

item.title: Zach Randolph on David Fizdale
item.description:
Ronald Tillery:Money quote from Zach Randolph on how David Fizdale delivered news of his decision:

“Being a man, telling me the why and why not. That’s all you can ask for.”

Zach Randolph on David Fizdale, Oct 5, 2016. Source: Twitter @CAGrizBeat.

item.title: Zach Randolph on David Fizdale
item.description:
Ronald Tillery:Zach Randolph:

“I’m fine with it. You know how I am. Whatever is best for the team. If Coach (David Fizdale) wants me to play 10 minutes, I’ll come in and play the hardest 10 minutes.”

Zach Randolph on David Fizdale, Oct 5, 2016. Source: Twitter @CAGrizBeat.
